# #4586: Patch: the Infinite Assault, C2, Hallucination
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part of #4601, the cards' fullsend tree (and of the tracker #4576). Card part **C2**: replace the stub scripts
CF (#4602) wrote for the cards below with their scripts and tests, base and Radiant, as cards of a held
single-player set. It builds beside the other card parts on the tree's integration branch; players see nothing
until the release (R).

The plan of record is [`docs/infinite-assault.md`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk/docs/infinite-assault.md): on `main` once C1 (#4577) merges, and until then on the planning branch `claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk`. Where it and SPEC disagree, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). Read its IA11 (the set, its ids, its hold, its tags and the design rules) and the comment CF leaves on
#4601 listing the verbs the set lacks.

Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), its rows for a card of a set that has not shipped above
all, and `spec/README.md` with the sections and rulings the cards touch (rule 1).

**Owns:** its cards' script files (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/cNNN_slug.rs`, IA-25 to IA-48
and their tokens), each entry's `loc` (`cargo jackioh catalog loc <path>`), and its own cards' rows in the
shared tables only where its build decides otherwise. CF wrote every other row. A verb, keyword or board fact the
engine lacks goes in the engine by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, in a file of its own where it can, with as few lines
in the shared engine files (`effects/mod.rs`, `script.rs`, `query.rs`, `wire/events.rs`) as possible, and its
test; the reconcile settles a seam with another part's.

## The cards

Card numbers are written `IA-n` here; in the spec and the catalog they are the set's own (`IA #25`,
`infiniteassault-025`, its tokens `infiniteassault-025-1`).

#### IA12.2 Hallucination, IA-25–IA-48

Bluff and backrow: Figments (Traps that do nothing), Cloaked Units, copies that fade. The player
learns to read the backrow; the Assault punishes reading it wrong.

- **IA-25 Mirage Weaver** — (1) Unit, Common, 1/3. Cry: Set a Figment. *Radiant:* 2/6. Cry: Set two Figments.
  - **IA-25.1 Figment** — token, Trap. Set at a random cost from (1) to (4). Reveals when an enemy Unit attacks: Nothing happens.
- **IA-26 Phantom Lancer** — (2) Unit, Common, 4/3. Cloaked. When this is revealed, deal 3 damage to an enemy Unit. *Radiant:* 8/6. … 6 damage …
- **IA-27 Decoy Projector** — (2) Unit, Common, 0/7. Taunt. Cry: Set a Figment. *Radiant:* 0/14. Taunt, Divine Shield. Cry: Set a Figment.
- **IA-28 Doppelganger Protocol** — (1) Spell, Common. Summon a copy of a random enemy Unit. It has Brittle 1. *Radiant:* … Brittle 3.
- **IA-29 False Positive** — (1) Trap, Common. Reveals when an enemy Unit attacks: Cancel the attack. Freeze the attacker. *Radiant:* … Then set a Figment.
- **IA-30 Smoke and Mirrors** — (2) Spell, Common. Set two Figments. Draw a card. *Radiant:* Set three Figments. Draw two cards.
- **IA-31 Unreliable Narrator** — (2) Unit, Common, 3/4. Cry: Look at the top three cards of your opponent's deck. Put one of them on the bottom. *Radiant:* 6/8. … Put two of them on the bottom.
- **IA-32 Glitch Specter** — (1) Unit, Common, 3/1. Evasive while you have a face-down card. *Radiant:* 6/2. Lifesteal. Evasive while you have a face-down card.
- **IA-33 Uncanny Valley** — (3) Unit, Common, 5/6. Cry: Enemy Units have −2 Attack until your next turn. *Radiant:* 10/12. … −4 Attack …
- **IA-34 Mass Hallucination** — (2) Spell, Rare. Transform every enemy Unit that costs (1) or less into a Husk. *Radiant:* … (2) or less …
  - **IA-34.1 Husk** — token, (1) Unit, 1/1.
- **IA-35 Fata Morgana** — (2) Unit, Rare, 3/5. Whenever a Figment of yours reveals, summon a Mirage. *Radiant:* 6/10. … summon a Radiant Mirage.
  - **IA-35.1 Mirage** — token, (1) Unit, 2/2. Rush.
- **IA-36 Deepfake** — (2) Spell, Rare. Choose an enemy Unit. Summon a copy of it for yourself with Brittle 2. *Radiant:* … a copy of it for yourself.
- **IA-37 Bluff Called** — (2) Trap, Rare. Reveals when your opponent plays a Spell: Counter it. *Radiant:* Counter it, then set a Figment.
- **IA-38 Imaginary Friend** — (1) Unit, Rare, 2/2. Divine Shield. Death: Set a Figment. *Radiant:* 4/4. … Death: Set two Figments.
- **IA-39 Shell Game** — (1) Spell, Rare. Set a Figment. Then draw a card for each face-down card you have, up to three. *Radiant:* … up to five.
- **IA-40 Hall of Mirrors** — (3) Field Spell, Rare. Whenever you set a card face-down, summon a Reflection. *Radiant:* … summon a Radiant Reflection.
  - **IA-40.1 Reflection** — token, (1) Unit, 1/3. Taunt.
- **IA-41 Phantom Army** — (3) Spell, Epic. Fill your empty unit zones with Phantoms. *Radiant:* … with Radiant Phantoms.
  - **IA-41.1 Phantom** — token, (1) Unit, 3/1. Rush, Brittle 1.
- **IA-42 Paranoia Engine** — (2) Unit, Epic, 2/6. Your opponent's cards can't destroy or reveal your face-down cards. End of turn: Set a Figment. *Radiant:* 4/12. … End of turn: Set two Figments.
- **IA-43 Cognitive Dissonance** — (2) Trap, Epic. Reveals when your opponent plays a Unit: Transform it into a random Unit that costs (1) less. *Radiant:* … (2) less.
- **IA-44 The Lie Detector** — (3) Unit, Epic, 4/8. Cry: Destroy every enemy face-down card. Set a Figment for each. *Radiant:* 8/16.
- **IA-45 Dream Within a Dream** — (4) Spell, Epic. Summon a copy of every enemy Unit for yourself. They have Brittle 1. *Radiant:* … Brittle 2.
- **IA-46 Mirage Sovereign** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 6/6. Cloaked. Whenever a Figment of yours reveals, summon a copy of the attacking Unit for yourself. *Radiant:* 12/12. … then destroy the attacking Unit.
- **IA-47 Unreal Estate** — (2) Field Trap, Legendary. Reveals whenever an enemy Unit attacks: 50% chance to cancel the attack. *Radiant:* Lucky 1. …
- **IA-48 Ego Death** — (3) Spell, Mythic. Swap hands with your opponent. The cards you get cost (1) less. *Radiant:* … (2) less.

## The design rules (IA11)

**The design rules every card part keeps.**

1. **Real cards.** Each card is legal in an ordinary game and plays the same in any mode; none reads the
   mode or its level. Commons to Legendaries of the doctrines and the Core sit on JackiOh's curve (costs
   (0) to (4); about 4 stats at (1), 8 at (2), 12 at (3), 16 at (4) for a Unit with little text, less with
   more), so they can be reused. Commander cards are boss cards, above the curve on purpose.
2. **Spicy, never unfair.** Swingy and rule-bending is the point, but every threat has an answer the player
   can see coming: a countdown is shown, a wall can be killed, a bluff can be called. Nothing makes the
   player lose with no counterplay, and nothing locks them out of playing for a turn they can't foresee
   (Kill Switch, IA-140, fires on a third card, which the player may choose not to play).
3. **Expressible.** The text uses verbs, keywords and filters the engine has (§6); where a card needs a new
   one, its part adds it by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, with its test. Numbers are `params` (`{damage}`),
   never literals (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
4. **Radiant is about twice the base face** (R275): doubled stats and a better line, never stats alone for
   a Unit with text. Each part writes its `docs/radiant-audit.md` rows.
5. **"Infinite Assault card"** in a card's text is a pool that names the set, which reaches the set while
   it is held (R1846001: a pool that names its set keeps to it). "Created" is the engine's Created mark.
6. **The AI must pilot it.** A card whose prompt the AI can't answer well is fixed or redesigned in its
   part, not shipped hoping.
7. **The part may tune.** A part may change a number, a word or a Radiant line where the engine or balance
   asks, keeping the card's role and its spice, and says so in its pull request; a bigger change goes in a
   ruling note.

## Done when

- Every card's script plays its base and Radiant faces by its §8.13 row, with tests in the same file for both
  (CLAUDE.md rule 6), and its `STUB (#4602)` header is gone; its entry's `loc` is the script's.
- Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note in this issue's block, a test named after it, and a
  paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3).
- Every new prompt is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
  --cards <each of its ids>` is green; `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for its cards.
- Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).

Blocked by #4602
